summary.text: Espoir Ngabo, a Green Party information-technology professional, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Texas's 7th Congressional District to Lizzie Fletcher.
He advanced from the Green Party convention on March 21, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ngabo describes a career of nearly a decade in information technology, supporting business systems and infrastructure. He says he is based in Houston and connected to the Alief, Sharpstown, and Gulfton communities.
In his Ballotpedia survey, he said his campaign accepted no corporate money.
He received 1.6% of the vote to Lizzie Fletcher's 70.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
